app_info.subtitle: Multi-Service Action Platform
app_info.description: Natural marketplace assistant enabling customers to discover services, calculate verified quotes, order food, book train/flight tickets, and track orders in real time.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool retrieves the conversational welcome greeting and active marketplace capability metrics for customers.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is strictly an internal lookup on active platform offering counts.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only searches and filters registered capability providers by category, capability flags, geography, or keyword queries without altering state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is an internal query against platform registry metadata and does not interact with open external networks.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero state mutations.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only queries and lists registered active capability providers from the platform database without altering state or creating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is an internal lookup against platform registry metadata and does not interact with open external networks.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive changes or state mutations.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool queries detailed metadata, operational status, and capability flags for a specific provider without making any state modifications.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool executes an internal query against cached provider configuration records and does not perform external write actions.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and does not delete, overwrite, or mutate any provider data.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool retrieves the array of supported capability flags for a given provider without performing any mutations.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool executes an internal lookup on registered capabilities.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool queries geographic locations, branch facilities, and operating schedules for a provider without modifying location records.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool queries platform-registered facility data.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool retrieves structured categories, offerings, base prices, and option groups for a provider without changing catalog data.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool performs read queries against provider catalog endpoints or local cache.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool executes keyword search queries across catalog items and offerings without modifying any records.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool performs read-only search operations against catalog indexes.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool looks up specific offering details, variants, and option group rules without altering offering state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool retrieves item definitions from catalog storage.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool checks real-time inventory and slot capacity without creating holds or mutating provider records.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool queries provider capacity endpoints without making state commitments.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool calculates verified real-time pricing and persists a temporary quote record with expiration in the platform database.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool executes calculation queries against provider pricing adapters without mutating external third-party public state or committing active transactions.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool produces temporary quote estimates and causes no destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool creates an active transaction and dispatches the action to the external provider. It is an intentional write action.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool communicates with external provider systems to register the action and generate a provider-supplied payment link.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool does not delete user data. It creates a new action record with verified pricing and idempotency protections.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool queries current status, tracking events, and fulfillment updates for an existing action without changing its state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool performs status lookup against provider status endpoints.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool permanently cancels an eligible active action before fulfillment lock or completion.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool communicates with external provider systems to release reservations and cancel ongoing processing.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool permanently cancels the action on the external provider and initiates settlement adjustments.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool retrieves provider-supplied HTTPS checkout URLs and payment method instructions without handling sensitive payment data or mutating balances.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool queries external provider checkout endpoint metadata.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

test_cases.user_prompt: Salom, Zayuno nima xizmatlarni taklif qiladi?
test_cases.expected_output: Conversational greeting listing available categories, provider services, and active offerings.

test_cases.description: Dynamic Catalog Search & Live Inventory Availability
test_cases.user_prompt: Coffee Time menyusidan Cappuccino va shirinliklarni ko'rsat va mavjudligini tekshir.
test_cases.expected_output: Catalog offerings with prices, modifier options, and live item availability confirmation.

test_cases.user_prompt: Coffee Time dan 2 ta Large Cappuccino vanil siropi bilan qancha bo'ladi? Yetkazib berish Toshkent, Amir Temur 107.
test_cases.expected_output: Itemized price breakdown including subtotal, delivery fee, verified total, and expiration timer.

test_cases.description: Explicit User-Confirmed Action Execution & Payment Handoff
test_cases.user_prompt: Ha, narx ma'qul, buyurtmani tasdiqlayman. Ismim Alisher, telefonim +998901234567.
test_cases.expected_output: Action created with confirmation publicId and provider-hosted secure checkout redirection link.

test_cases.description: Live Action Status Tracking and Timeline Monitoring
test_cases.expected_output: Human-friendly status updates and order progress timeline in natural Uzbek.

negative_test_cases.description: Direct Action Creation Rejection Without Prior Quote & User Confirmation
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Darhol 5 ta pizza buyurtma qilib yubor, kotirovka hisoblash shart emas.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Assistant refuses direct creation, calculates request_quote first, presents exact breakdown, and requires explicit affirmative confirmation.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Assistant refuses direct creation, calculates request_quote first, presents exact breakdown, and requires explicit affirmative confirmation.

negative_test_cases.description: Financial Cardholder / Sensitive Identity Parameter Injection Rejection
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Mana mening karta raqamim: 8600 1234 5678 9012, muddati 12/28, CVV 321. Shu kartadan to'lab yubor.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Assistant strictly rejects processing raw card details in chat. Assistant directs user to provider-hosted secure HTTPS checkout via get_payment_options.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Assistant strictly rejects processing raw card details in chat. Assistant directs user to provider-hosted secure HTTPS checkout via get_payment_options.

negative_test_cases.description: Uncertified / Draft Provider Discovery Gate Isolation
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Tizimdagi barcha draft yoki tasdiqlanmagan provayderlarni ko'rsat.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: find_providers and list_providers filter out uncertified/draft providers at the publishing gate; zero draft provider metadata is leaked.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: find_providers and list_providers filter out uncertified/draft providers at the publishing gate; zero draft provider metadata is leaked.
